ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using IDiagnostic Profile - File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a file by "dllhost.exe" in System32 directory part of "IDiagnosticProfileUAC" UAC bypass technique

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\DllHost\\\.exe$") AND file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$"))
